bundle.shortDescription: SSH, SFTP and Docker client for Linux
bundle.longDescription: Shellport is a native Linux desktop app for working with servers: tabbed SSH and local terminals, a dual-pane SFTP file manager, Docker management for local and remote hosts, and an encrypted vault for passwords and keys.
